title: 한국 생활 1년: 요즘 어때요?
objective: Talk about your feelings about life in Korea, and use -어 가다 for changes still happening.
summary: A Korean friend asks a foreigner how his almost one year in Korea has gone.
setting: A café near a Korean language school. Minji, a Korean friend, asks Daniel how his life in Korea is going.

task.title: Talk about life in Korea
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, complete, order, or answer each item.

words.meaning: to be almost time for something; to be nearly done
to be unfamiliar or new to you
words.example: 처음 이사 왔을 때는 동네가 낯설었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: When I first moved here, the neighborhood felt strange to me.
I've gotten used to spicy food now.

words.meaning: to adjust or settle in (to a new place or life)
words.example: 새 회사에 적응하는 데 석 달쯤 걸렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It took me about three months to settle in at my new company.
I still can't understand dialects well.
I was alone during the holiday, so I felt a little lonely.

words.example: 드라마를 많이 봐서 듣기 실력이 늘었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I watched a lot of dramas, so my listening got better.

words.meaning: to be touched or moved (by kindness)
words.example: 이웃이 김치를 나눠 줘서 정말 감동받았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My neighbor shared kimchi with me, and I was really touched.

dialogue.korean: 다니엘 씨, 한국에 온 지 벌써 1년이 다 돼 가네요.
dialogue.meaning: Daniel, it's already almost been a year since you came to Korea.

dialogue.korean: 네, 시간이 정말 빨리 가요. 처음에는 모든 게 낯설었는데 이제 조금씩 익숙해져 가요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, time really flies. At first everything was unfamiliar, but now I'm slowly getting used to it.
What was the hardest thing about life in Korea?

dialogue.korean: 음식은 괜찮았는데 사람들이 말을 빨리 해서 알아듣기 어려웠어요. 그래서 처음에는 좀 외로웠어요.
dialogue.meaning: The food was fine, but people talked fast, so it was hard to understand them. So I felt a bit lonely at first.

dialogue.korean: 한국 친구들도 생기고 한국어도 늘어서 요즘은 하루하루가 즐거워요.
dialogue.meaning: I've made Korean friends and my Korean has improved, so these days every day is fun.
What's the best thing about Korea?

dialogue.korean: 어디든 지하철로 쉽게 갈 수 있어서 정말 편해요. 그리고 사람들이 친절해서 감동받은 적도 많아요.
dialogue.meaning: You can go anywhere easily by subway, so it's really convenient. And people were so kind that I was often touched.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the -어 가요 form of 끝나다: 방학이 거의 ____.
Choose the right expression: 이사 온 지 반년이 지나니까 동네가 점점 (낯설어요 / 익숙해져 가요).
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 적응해 / 회사 생활에 / 가요 / 조금씩
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 다니엘 씨는 한국 생활에서 무엇이 제일 편해요?
answers: 회사 생활에 조금씩 적응해 가요. (조금씩 회사 생활에 적응해 가요.)
어디든 지하철로 쉽게 갈 수 있는 게 제일 편해요. (지하철이 편해요.)
